repair_title: D4-A2-V2-R3 Forward-Only Evaluator Contract Repair Preregistration
document_type: forward-only evaluator contract repair preregistration (frozen before real recomputation)

defect_attribution.description: Historical D4-A2-V2 evaluator suffered from two critical defects: (1) schema mismatch where the evaluator read inputs.symbols instead of the actual frozen raw cell schema inputs.symbol_inputs and omitted arm/config evidence, causing BEFORE locator inputs to be reported as inactive; (2) coupling in Level 3 where primary target replacement was coupled with batch1_dependency_removed < 2, causing dependency removal contrast failure to masquerade as PRIMARY_TARGET_REPLACEMENT failure even when target replacement was reproduced 2/2 with valid governed witness.

resolution_contract.historical_semantics: An active BEFORE fixed-locator contrast is required to demonstrate dependency removal.
resolution_contract.authority_rationale: The V2 preregistration preserves dependency_removal_required = 2 / 2 without redefining its predicate. The earlier frozen D4-A2 preregistration defines dependency removal through five conjuncts beginning with fixed locator inputs active in BEFORE, and the historical evaluator implements the same five-part contrast. D4-A1 independently established the underlying fixed-locator dependency. Resolution B therefore preserves the inherited contrast semantics while separating non-identifiability from target-replacement failure.
resolution_contract.identifiability_rule: Inactive BEFORE locator input means dependency_removal_identifiable=false and dependency_removal_demonstrated=false. This is an unidentifiable contrast, strictly NOT a primary-target replacement failure.
resolution_contract.concrete_protocol_determination: Determine BEFORE activity from the frozen raw cell's correct inputs.symbol_inputs plus lack of effective suppression in BEFORE, not from current metric outcomes.

five_generic_conjuncts: 2. Exact masked locator absent AFTER (after_fixed_locator_absent = true)
3. Governed structured mechanism active AFTER (structured_replacement_active = true, admission_budget_k = 3)

schema_repair.after_absence_rule: Based on effective suppression / masked execution semantics rather than falsely demanding removal from the shared canonical plan text

resolution_b_inconclusive.rule: Narrowly defined for the logically possible state where target replacement is 2/2 but dependency removal is not identifiable because BEFORE was inactive. Merely demonstrated=false is NOT inconclusive if identifiable.

level_3.restoration: Restored to target_replacement_reproduced < 2 only; must never be triggered solely by dependency removal

historical_exposed_output.contract_conflict: The historical evaluator triggered Level 3 when target_replacement_reproduced < 2 OR batch1_dependency_removed < 2, while the frozen V2 Level-3 contract triggers only when a primary target is not retained under AFTER with a valid governed replacement witness.
